newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Country Road appoints two directors.
newsitem.headline: Country Road appoints two directors.

text.p: Clothing and homeware retailer Country Road Ltd said on Friday that it had appointed the chief of catering group Spotless Services Ltd, Ron Evans, and former media executive Dulcie Boling as directors.

"Ms Boling and Mr Evans already have a detailed knowledge of our industry and will bring new skills and service industry experience to our board," Country Road chairman Bill Loewenthal said in a statement.
Boling, also a director of the Seven Network Ltd, and Evans join four other non-executive directors on the Country Road board, he said.
